# Bootskills — Practical Tech & Business Training in Kigali, Rwanda
> Bootskills is Rwanda's leading practical training platform offering tech, business, and financial literacy courses with real-world projects and internships.
> Website: https://bootskills.com
> Location: Kigali, Rwanda
> Founded: 2024 by Manzi Alain Patrick Munyeshuri and Bizimana Eric

## Core Offerings

### Training & Courses
- Full-Stack Web Development (React, Node.js, TypeScript)
- Mobile App Development
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Data Science & Analytics
- UI/UX Design
- Business Development & Management
- Digital Literacy & Financial Literacy

### Internships
- Structured internship programs with real projects
- Professional mentorship from industry experts
- Team-based collaboration on production software
- Certificate upon completion

### Software Development
- Custom web and mobile applications
- AI-powered solutions
- API development and integration
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP)

### Innovation Platform
- Open ecosystem for trainers and professionals
- Project-based learning methodology
- Industry-aligned curriculum
